hierarchy_reference: OMOP release: src_partner_wh.omop_cdm_2016 (executable on the arm SQL warehouse).

Value columns hold Standard Library permissible-value ids (PRT...). Bridge: partner_library_test.standard_library.standard_library_concept.concept_prt_id = value, then concept_athena_id is the OMOP concept_id of that value (often a non-standard ICDO3 concept).
Maps to (concept_relationship.relationship_id = 'Maps to', concept_id_1 -> concept_id_2) moves a non-standard concept to its standard concept. It is a mapping, not ancestry.

Ancestry: src_partner_wh.omop_cdm_2016.concept_ancestor(ancestor_concept_id, descendant_concept_id, min_levels_of_separation, max_levels_of_separation). ancestor_concept_id is the broader concept. Standard concepts have a self row (ancestor = descendant, min_levels_of_separation = 0), so 'X or a descendant of X' is descendant_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id ... WHERE ancestor_concept_id = X).

OMOP concept_id (integer) is not a vocabulary code. Resolve a named concept through src_partner_wh.omop_cdm_2016.concept (concept_name, vocabulary_id, standard_concept = 'S'); concept_code with vocabulary_id is the source code.
